financeContract.currentDefect: Visible Movimientos/CxP/CxC use browser-memory finStore and do not constitute the canonical durable source for Dashboard income.
target: Every financial mutation is durable, provider-backed, ACK-aware and idempotent.
A generic income movement does not automatically prove operating revenue.
Operating income becomes known only from an authorized durable source for exact tenant+project+period+country+currency and a revenue classification allowed by the project financial model.
Invoice/revenue recognition and cash collection remain distinct when the project model distinguishes them; a collection linked to CxC reduces the receivable without double-counting revenue.
Financing is non-operating cash inflow and creates/updates linked CxP; repayment reduces that CxP and never inflates operating income.
Shopper obligations derive from canonical realized/liquidation truth; payment is never inferred from liquidation.
Payment batch/internal payment event stays pending external reconciliation until paymentSourceRef/audit evidence exists.
CxP, CxC, Movimientos, Liquidaciones, Lotes and Dashboard are projections of one durable event graph; country/currency never mix.

selfRegistration.geographyLabels: data-driven by country; do not hardcode Guatemala globally
selfRegistration.departmentOrRegion: retained as an additional country-specific administrative level when applicable

hrAutoUpsert.rule: HR-managed automatic shopper upsert must remain idempotent and must not be blocked by missing country/municipality/city profile-completion fields.

login: One deterministic human flow: choose access type, then credentials.
Authenticate once; preserve selected role through retry.
Enter usable shell immediately after authorized session/context is established.
Do not re-show login unless authentication actually failed or expired.
liveData: Do not block the whole shell on every HR refresh.
Use already-authorized durable state immediately and refresh HR in-place.
Use sourceRevision + bounded freshness TTL to avoid redundant reads/recomposition.
A non-HR-managed write must not invalidate the entire HR authority.
Preserve route, scroll and module context after writes.
Expose one human freshness/loading status, never successive technical phases.
